name: cloud-event-signup-system
description: Full-stack event management system for ministry events

scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@atcloud/shared-time && npm run build --workspace=atcloud-signup-system-backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.check:coverage: npm run -s coverage:backend && npm run -s coverage:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd backend && npm run lint:fix && cd ../frontend && npm run lint:fix
scripts.type-check: cd backend && npm run type-check && cd ../frontend && npm run type-check
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run check:deployment-guardrails
scripts.verify:local: npm run -s verify && npm run -s check:no-only
scripts.clean-install:frontend: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules && npm install
scripts.clean-install:backend: cd backend && rm -rf node_modules && npm install
scripts.clean-install: npm run clean-install:backend && npm run clean-install:frontend
scripts.pre-deploy: npm run clean-install && npm run verify && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check-deps: cd backend && npm ls --depth=0 && cd ../frontend && npm ls --depth=0
